Upgrade

The PostgreSQL database incorporates many features including behaving like NoSQL Database from version 12.

Many implementations have been done across industry verticles, by many Companies and are used for many projects.

The organization started using version 15, the most stable version with additional features.

Now, arises the requirement of Upgrading the Database along with the software. Hence Upgrade of Database.

Migration

The initial implementation was done without giving importance to the Platform, OS, or Database design.

As the usage increased, optimizing the database for Performance enhancement & Availability was Provisioned.

The way to achieve the use of a Newer Platform with a desired OS and optimal database design is required.

Hence Migration of the database is required.

Special Indexes

The PostgreSQL DB accommodates Special types of data seamlessly.

The special type of data that is stored is usually Unstructured data, the regular indexes used in RDBMS are not suitable.

Hence the Special Indexes are required and used.

Use As NoSQL DB

The very reason PostgreSQL has become popular is its capability to accommodate NoSQL Data seamlessly.

The RDBMS facility in PostgreSQL is used for NoSQL data.

Using PostgreSQL as a NoSQL database with the RDBMS facility such as Table, SQL, DML, etc.

PostgreSQL DB is used as a NoSQL Database Seamlessly.
